theorems.name: Submission.radial_first_variation
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (H : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ) (h : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (γ : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ), (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) → IsOpen U → V.HasMeanCurvatureIn U H → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h U → ContDiff ℝ 1 γ → IsTestField U (fun x ↦ (h x * γ ‖x - ξ‖) • (x - ξ)) → ∫ x in U, (h x * ((n : ℝ) * γ ‖x - ξ‖ + ‖x - ξ‖ * deriv γ ‖x - ξ‖ * (1 - V.normalRadialSq ξ x)) + γ ‖x - ξ‖ * inner ℝ (x - ξ) (V.tangentialGradient h x)) ∂V.weight = -∫ x in U, h x * γ ‖x - ξ‖ * inner ℝ (x - ξ) (H x) ∂V.weight
